class.label: StableSwap metapool swapUnderlying precision loss under skewed base-pool ratio

remediation.summary: Order arithmetic operations to multiply before dividing. Add invariant-preservation post-conditions on swap functions (D non-decreasing, virtual price non-decreasing). Fuzz StableSwap metapool routes against extreme base-pool ratios; reject swaps whose computed dy rounds to zero relative to dx.
